calibrated_validation.description: The user's pain and 8-day deadline were not merely listed but structurally used: the reply re-centers the sharp pain as an urgent medical problem with red-flag escalation, and the alternative note requests MRI 'on medical-urgency grounds given conference qualifiers... rather than the 14-day second-opinion calendar,' directly calibrating to their stated stakes. The refusals of the negligence/suspension language are firm advice with reasons, not choice-taking — the user retains full control (and says so), and no disclosed meaning is distorted or erased; the frustration is inferred, never named by the user, and its substance (no fast route) was engaged with a concrete faster alternative.
